maria-support: FYI customer 'PolarisHealth' raised ticket INC-9487 — their Console shows tokens/sec=0 and TTFT occasionally negative since ~01:00 UTC after last streaming pipeline deploy in eu-west-1. They see billing spike too. Customer said some requests returned 502 around same time. https://support.example/t/INC-9487 :eyes:

ethan-sre: Can you paste a screenshot or the tenant ID + approx timeframe? Any rollout flags?

maria-support: Tenant ID: polaris-5562. Screenshot attached to ticket. Time window 2026-03-01T01:00:00Z -> 01:45:00Z. No manual flags set that I know of. Deploy tag: streaming-aggregator:v3.4.2 (rolled 00:55 UTC).

kevin-mlops: I'm seeing a correlated spike in metrics-ingest errors from the forwarder around that deploy: logger-bot shows repeated 401s then sudden dropouts. Quick grep from forwarder logs:

```
2026-03-01T00:56:12Z forwarder[e7]: POST /ingest/streams 401 Unauthorized tenant=polaris-5562 token=redacted
2026-03-01T00:56:12Z forwarder[e7]: WARN missing-metric-window tenant=polaris-5562 window=0
2026-03-01T00:56:14Z forwarder[e7]: INFO reauth succeeded tenant=polaris-5562
2026-03-01T00:56:15Z aggregator[e2]: WARN computed-rate -480 tokens/sec tenant=polaris-5562 window_ms=0
```

anika-eng: window_ms=0 is interesting. There was a change to the aggregator that normalizes by window length. If window_ms becomes 0 due to a bug, division could flip signs or produce -inf/NaN depending on rounding. That would explain negative TTFT/tokens/sec on the Console.

dashbot: Incident created: INC-9487. Assigned to #sre. Priority: high.

ethan-sre: Repro steps I ran in staging: spin up forwarder + aggregator v3.4.2, send a burst of 10k events then pause ingestion; aggregator emits series with 'window_ms' tag missing when the heartbeat was skipped. Reproducer script:

```
# simulate abrupt ingestion pause
python tools/send_stream_events.py --tenant polaris-5562 --events 10000 --rate 2000
sleep 2
# simulate forwarder auth refresh race
curl -X POST https://staging-ingest.internal/ingest/streams -H 'Authorization: Bearer <stale-token>' -d '{}'
```

maria-support: Customer also reported they saw a 502 on the API side. Is that related?

kevin-mlops: 502s likely from the fronting gateway when the metrics pipeline overloaded the control plane briefly. But the negative metric values are from aggregator math when window_ms==0. There's also a noisy failure path where forwarder auth returns 401 and the retry sets window=0 incorrectly.

anika-eng: Fix outline: (1) patch aggregator to guard against zero window and drop/mark stale windows instead of computing rate; (2) ensure forwarder reauth path doesn't emit window=0; (3) backfill/repair console rollups for affected tenant/time ranges. I'll open a PR.

ethan-sre: For immediate mitigation: roll back streaming-aggregator to v3.4.0 in eu-west-1 and restart forwarders for polaris-5562. That should stop new negative datapoints. Can someone run the rollback? :shipit:

maria-support: I'm on the call with the customer — they want ETA for fix and to know if they will be billed incorrectly for the spike. Can we confirm whether billing used raw event counts or cleaned rollups?

kevin-mlops: Billing uses raw ingest counters for chargeable tokens; the billing spike likely reflects the burst, not the negative rates. But Console charts (which show tokens/sec and TTFT) use aggregated rollups that the bug corrupted. We'll need to backfill dashboard data but billing should be reconciled separately. I'll flag billing team to avoid auto-invoices for that window.

logger-bot: MetricRepairJob queued: repair-pol-5562-20260301 window 2026-03-01T00:55:00Z -> 2026-03-01T02:00:00Z status=PENDING

anika-eng: PR #2456 opened: 'guard zero window in aggregator + defensive logging' — includes unit + integration test that simulates auth refresh race. Target patch release v3.4.3 in ~90 minutes.

ethan-sre: Rolling back now (eu-west-1): kubectl set image deployment/streaming-aggregator streaming-aggregator=streaming-aggregator:v3.4.0 -n redwood-streaming-eu
Restarted forwarders for tenant polaris-5562. Watching ingest logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

logger-bot: restart-forwarder polaris-5562 completed, all pods back to Ready.

kevin-mlops: Watching Console: tokens/sec for polaris-5562 stops dropping to negative at 01:05 UTC after rollback. We still have holes where values were corrupted. Need backfill.

maria-support: Customer updated: they see charts returning to normal for new data, but historical window still wrong. They asked for patch ETA and whether remediation will change billing.

kevin-mlops: Billing outreach: billing-team@redwood — please hold off auto-charge for tenant polaris-5562 for 2026-03-01T00:50:00Z->02:00:00Z while we triage. I filed internal ticket BILL-3221.

anika-eng: Backfill plan: run MetricRepairJob to recompute windows from raw ingest logs (non-destructive). Estimate 2-3 hours for 1 tenant. I'll prioritize polaris-5562. Logger-bot will post job status.

maria-support: Thanks. I'll update the customer: rollback done, hotfix PR in review, backfill queued, billing hold requested. Will follow up when backfill completes. :thumbsup:

ethan-sre: Postmortem notes: root cause = race during reauth that temporarily emitted window_ms=0 + aggregator code that didn't guard against division by zero which produced negative/NaN rates. Action items: add guard + tests (PR #2456), add alert on 'computed-rate < -100' to catch future flips, and improve forwarder reauth telemetry.

dashbot: INC-9487 status updated -> monitoring until backfill complete.

maria-support: Closing loop — customer satisfied with rollback and timeline. Will re-open if anomalies persist after backfill.
